content:
“Cool people don't look at explosions.”

**Grenadier** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Your explosives detonate with a wider radius.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your explosives detonate with twice the radius. | 00393F69 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your explosives detonate with a 50% larger radius. | 00393F66 | 

The following weapons are affected by this perk:

- All throwable explosives, except Vertibot signal grenades.
- All explosive heavy guns.
- All Gauss weapons.
- Tesla rifle (see bugs).
- All weapons with the Explosive legendary mod equipped and functioning.

- Before patch 1.6.0.17, the Grenadier perk did not affect the radius of any explosion and was completely broken. **[patched]** 
- Increases the arc range for the Tesla rifle. [verified]
